criteria.ADMIT-EXACT-TRANSFORM: Every required artifact is accounted for with exact body/result, metadata, navigation and build edges; no silent omission, truncation, fabricated input version or inherited approval.
criteria.ADMIT-SOURCE-BINDINGS: Exact pinned package/source/protocol/implementation and current captured input membership/versions match candidate; unavailable input or changed recipe/authority/validity/gaps refuses.
criteria.ADMIT-SEMANTIC-SCOPE: Each entry maps its actual independent semantic evidence, applicable obligations and limitations. Two new exact admission decisions cover the entry contract/input/result. Historical semantic approval is evidence only; no operational AC PASS is inferred.
criteria.ADMIT-ISOLATED-PLAN: Persistent evaluation authority, finite plan, isolated state and verified policy constrain every supported reader/writer/replay/export path. Default operational selection refuses evaluation. No phase mutation or automatic promotion.

applicability.per_entry_semantic_mapping: Mandatory exact refs plus explicit limits; omissions are HOLD, not automatic N/A.
applicability.final_obligations: Original AC01–10, 50-ID matrix, oracles and DoD unchanged and referenced immutably; admission PASS never fulfills them.
